title: Pokemon TCG Pocket Cards V5 Collection No Image Schema
description: One record per printed card (3,879), the complement of the gameplay projection, without image URLs. Records are sparse: a field is omitted when it does not apply. The trading fields tradable, sharable and trade_cost are derived from rarity, shiny and art style, so every record carries tradable and sharable while trade_cost is null for non-tradable rarities.

id.description: Set prefix and padded card number (e.g., "a1-001").

name.description: The printed name of the card.

set_name.description: The full name of the expansion the card belongs to.

pack.description: The specific pack the card drops from, or the expansion name itself.

release_date.description: The release date of the expansion, in ISO 8601 format.

pack_points.description: The cost to craft the card. Omitted for promos, which cannot be crafted.

art_style.description: The visual treatment category (e.g., "Full Art", "Shiny", "Illustration Art"). Omitted when the card has none.

artist.description: The credited artist of the card.

flavour_text.description: The lore text printed on the card.

alternate_versions.description: Prints from other sets mapping `set_code`, `set_name`, `id`, and `rarity`.

set_code.description: The normalised lowercase set code of the alternate print.

set_name.description: The full name of the expansion of the alternate print.

id.description: The card number within the alternate set.

rarity.description: The visual rarity indicator of the alternate print.

ex.description: True if the card is an "ex" rulebox Pokémon.

mega.description: True if the card is a Mega Evolution.

shiny.description: True if the card is a shiny variant.

special_tags.description: Tags like "ancient", "future", or "ultra_beasts". Present only when the card carries a tag.

tradable.description: True if the card can be traded with other players.

sharable.description: True if the card can be sent as a wonder pick.

trade_cost.description: The number of trading tokens required to trade for the card, or null when it is not tradable.
